title: Irish Apple Grilled Chicken
description: A sweet and savory dish featuring grilled chicken, tender apples, and a hint of Irish flair.
instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together yogurt, honey, cumin, cayenne pepper (if using), salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken to the bowl and coat with the yogurt mixture, making sure to get some under the skin as well.
Let the chicken marinate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 2 hours in the refrigerator.
Grill the chicken for 5-7 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F.
Meanwhile, slice the apple into wedges.
Grill the apple for 2-3 minutes per side, or until it has a nice char.
Serve the grilled chicken with the apple wedges on top.
Garnish with fresh herbs, if desired.
